apps.name: BitChord
apps.subtitle: Open-source YouTube Music client for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: A native SwiftUI port of BitChord for Android. Search, browse and play the YouTube Music catalogue, with synced lyrics from a dozen providers, downloads, crossfade, Automix, SMB and WebDAV libraries, Last.fm scrobbling and Listen Together. Requires iOS 17 or later.

versions.localizedDescription:
Improves playback on slow connections and resolves tester reported issues.

New
- Send lyrics as a card, choose which lines to include.
- Direct source streaming (new option that is disabled by default). "Queue only" starts upcoming songs in the queue on a higher priority source found ahead of time. "Always" waits up to 12 seconds for one on each track. YouTube will still be used as fallback.
- Lockscreen animated covers.
- App icon selector in Settings (5 icons).
- Audio Quality shown in Discord card when hovering over the cover.
- Sign-in and Scrobbling working with Last.fm.
- Log file is stored on the device. This can be shared via the Settings (row) or disabled.

Fixed
- Songs will now start playing on a slow connection and will no longer cut out or jump to the next song.
- Crossfade will no longer lag.
- Songs would cut out halfway through due to downloading in the background.
- A song can no longer be replaced by a copy more than 5 seconds longer or shorter than it.
- Lyrics would get ahead if you skip through the song. Now in sync again.
- Offline Backup set to Always now plays from the device.
- Cover is now shown with the player and if you skip it shows the next cover instantly.
- Downloads will now restart the track if a partial file goes missing. Songs that have been duplicated are also counted once.
- Long lists can be scrolled through without rebuilding each row.

Overwrite the previous app. Downloads, Library & Settings are retained.

Install from the sideload source `https://bitchord.hero154.com/source.json`. The attached IPA is build 9, the same file as on the source. SHA-256: 96da0c1248ca33fee6e9bba4de369fc63c76caced3f6ec487f3a332e0196af42.
